figurative_meaning_en: fellow disciple or co-disciple sharing the same spiritual teacher
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা ধর্মভাই হিসেবে একসাথে গুরুর পাশে দাঁড়িয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: They stood together by the guru as dharma brothers.
My fellow disciple came to help me.
history: Rooted in the ancient Indian guru-shishya parampara tradition, emphasizing spiritual kinship in Hinduism and other faiths.
note: Commonly used in contexts of shared religious or spiritual mentorship.
